--- docker-compose ---

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: local_postgres
    ports:
      - ${DATABASE_PORT}:5432
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=${DATABASE_USER}
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${DATABASE_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=${DATABASE_DB}
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  pgdata:
--- .env.example ---
# Database configuration
APP_ENV=local

# dev db
DATABASE_TYPE=postgres  # Options: postgres, duckdb
DATABASE_LOCAL_PATH=data/db.duckdb
DATABASE_HOST=example.database.host
DATABASE_PORT=5432
DATABASE_DB=vollstaendigkeitspruefung-db
DATABASE_USER=vollstaendigkeitspruefung_db
DATABASE_PASSWORD=your_secure_password
# local db
#DATABASE_TYPE=duckdb  # Options: postgres, duckdb
#DATABASE_LOCAL_PATH=data/db.duckdb
#DATABASE_HOST=localhost
#DATABASE_PORT=5432
#DATABASE_DB=vollstaendigkeit
#DATABASE_USER=postgres
#DATABASE_PASSWORD=your_secure_password

# LLM (on-prem model) configuration
LLM_ENDPOINT=https://inference.example.com/v1/
LLM_FALLBACK_ENDPOINT=https://inference-fallback.example.com/v1/
LLM_API_KEY=your_llm_api_key
LLM_DEFAULT_MODEL=your_llm_model

# Embedding configuration
EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT=https://embedding.example.com/v1/
EMBEDDING_FALLBACK_ENDPOINT=https://embedding-fallback.example.com/v1/
EMBEDDING_API_KEY=your_embedding_api_key
EMBEDDING_DEFAULT_MODEL=embedding-Model

# Package configuration
UV_INDEX_USERNAME=username
UV_INDEX_PASSWORD=PAT

# Plausibilitaetspruefung configuration
PP_SIMILARITY_ANALYSIS_METRIC=cosine
PP_SIMILARITY_ANALYSIS_THRESHOLD=0.95

# RabbitMQ Settings
RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://guest:guest@localhost:5672/
RABBITMQ_QUEUE_NAME=dokumentenpruefung
FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB=30

# Prompt Security (prompt-security package)
PROMPT_SECURITY_ENABLED=true  # Enable/disable prompt injection protection

# Validierungsmethodik integration
KI_GUV_EXPLAINABILITY_API_BASE_URL=https://explainability-transparency-api.dev-env.example.com/v1/
KI_GUV_EXPLAINABILITY_SCORE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=45
KI_GUV_EXPLAINABILITY_SCORE_MAX_RETRIES=1
KI_GUV_EXPLAINABILITY_SCORE_PARALLEL_REQUESTS=1

# Dokumentenaufbereitung Settings
DOKUMENTENAUFBEREITUNG_DATA_SERVICE_URL=https://dokumentenaufbereitung-data-service.example.com/v1/
DOKUMENTENAUFBEREITUNG_MONOREPO_URL=https://dokumentenaufbereitung-monorepo.example.com/v1/
MAX_LENGTH_DOCUMENT_CONTENT=50000

# BIZLOG_PUBLISH_TIMEOUT: Socket timeout in seconds for bizlog RabbitMQ publish calls (bizlog >= 0.3.6)
# Default: 5.0 — increase in high-latency environments
BIZLOG_PUBLISH_TIMEOUT=5.0

# BIZLOG_FALLBACK_ONLY: false = send events to RabbitMQ pipeline (production)
#                       true = log locally only (local dev mode, disables audit trail)
BIZLOG_FALLBACK_ONLY=true

# BIZLOG_LOCAL_LOGS: true = emit logs to console/stdout (local dev)
#                    false = suppress local log output (only send to RabbitMQ in production)
BIZLOG_LOCAL_LOGS=true

# BIZLOG_LOG_FORMAT: structured = JSON formatted logs (production)
#                    text = text logs (local dev)
BIZLOG_LOG_FORMAT=structured

# BIZLOG_AUDIT_ENABLED: true = enable audit-safe logging for AI decisions and human approvals
#                       false = disable audit-safe logging (use plain business events only)
# Required: true for services that touch AI suggestions or human decision steps
BIZLOG_AUDIT_ENABLED=true

# BIZLOG_AUDIT_SIGNING_KEY: Cryptographic key for HMAC signing of audit events
# Source: K8s secret in deployed environments, never hardcoded inline
# Local development: generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"
# Leave empty in local dev to trigger graceful fallback (audit logging will be unavailable)
BIZLOG_AUDIT_SIGNING_KEY=""

# BIZLOG_AUDIT_ENDPOINT: Where audit events are sent (if audit is enabled)
# Default: derived from BIZLOG_* settings, usually RabbitMQ pipeline URL
# Leave empty for default behavior
BIZLOG_AUDIT_ENDPOINT=

SERVICE_NAME=dokumentenpruefung

DEFAULT_EVENT_VERSION=1.0

SERVICE_ENVIRONMENT=dev
